text: A piano teacher moves his pregnant wife and two children into a [larger two-storey house|trigger|making a new home] and hires Myung-Sook, a factory cleaner who catches rats with her bare hands and spies on the family. After she watches him reject a pupil's advances, she blackmails him into an affair, and [the household slowly becomes hers|wants|taking someone's place]. She [threatens to kill his newborn son|threat|people who kill], and family life narrows to [a steep flight of stairs|images|the house and its rooms], a glass of water and a dose of rat poison.
